title: Acta rows — folder-tab categorization
brief: Redesign of the live acta event rows (mobile 390px): the category chip was stealing width from the description and SPP appeared as the row title. User direction: a folder with a tab — category on a top-left tab (Casualty / Ambos derribados / Pase...), description with full width, and earned SPP only on a bottom-right tab, only when earned.

artboards.title: A · Folder tabs
artboards.tradeoff: Closest to the user's folder idea: top-left category tab + inverted SPP tab bottom-right; stacked rows get taller

artboards.title: B · Side tab
artboards.tradeoff: Vertical category tab keeps the maximum description width at all times; vertical text is slightly harder to scan

artboards.title: C · Archiver label
artboards.tradeoff: Strong archival character with the perforated band and SPP stamp; more visual noise than the other two

artboards.title: D · Mirror chat
artboards.tradeoff: Fullest side identity (chat-like); mirrored text alignment can read slightly awkward

artboards.title: E · Identity tab
artboards.tradeoff: Folder structure stays stable, only the identity edge + tab side mirror; side reads at a glance, content never mirrors

artboards.title: F · Player badge
artboards.tradeoff: Player-first (dorsal+name badge): clearest WHO acted; slightly busier rows
